displayName: Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub — internal runs

completeness.expectedCountMethod: Inspect all 77 ZIP files and 76 CSV files, separating 75 root benchmark-result CSVs into eleven Epoch-hosted files (ECI plus ten direct files) and 64 external-source mirrors, while identifying the supplemental ECI parameter CSV.

notes: Only files without the _external suffix are treated as Epoch-run evidence.
ECI is an Epoch-owned ORGANIZER composite. It contributes a dynamic Top 20 selection set, deduplicated by base model and retained as excluded, selection-only evidence.
When a base model has tied ECI scores, the profile with the highest declared reasoning effort is retained deterministically.
The materializer enumerates every finite-score row from the eight previously mapped direct result files plus ECI; rows without a canonical product identity remain reviewable CandidateResults.

The refreshed ZIP also contains 47 Earthborne Rangers rows and 6 MirrorCode rows. They remain preserved in the raw artifact but are not promoted until shared benchmark IDs and dimension mappings are approved.
Epoch Inspect harness and attempt metadata remain in raw Profile provenance but do not create Product Profiles.
